description:
nyctaxi, clickbench, and amplab benchmarks do not set csv_null_marker in their
generator manifest metadata.  SingleStore LOAD DATA INFILE in strict mode requires
NULL DEFINED BY to handle nullable integer columns; without it, empty fields hit
error 1264 "Out of range value for column".

nyctaxi sets csv_null_marker=None explicitly (core/nyctaxi/benchmark.py:294);
clickbench sets csv_null_marker=None (core/clickbench/generator.py:390); amplab
sets nothing.  nyctaxi at minimum has nullable integer columns and will fail as
soon as a SingleStore smoke test runs against it.

This is pre-existing — not introduced by the CSV-loading work — but was surfaced
during that review.  Address before pointing SingleStore smoke tests at these
benchmarks.

preserves.behavior: No live SingleStore server required for verification
TPC benchmark CSV dialects are unchanged; only nyctaxi/clickbench/amplab gain an explicit marker
csv_null_marker='' (empty string), not None, so NULL DEFINED BY is actually emitted

verifications.description: Manifest-driven loading / dialect resolution coverage passes

work_units.notes:
Pass csv_null_marker="" into each benchmark's write_generator_manifest()
call so manifest path (a) wins and the resolved dialect carries an explicit
NULL marker:
  - benchbox/core/clickbench/generator.py:385 (currently None)
  - benchbox/core/amplab/generator.py:392 (currently sets nothing)
  - benchbox/core/nyctaxi/benchmark.py:294 (currently None explicitly)
Empty string is the correct marker: SingleStore LOAD DATA INFILE emits
NULL DEFINED BY '' so empty fields in nullable integer columns load as NULL
instead of raising error 1264.
work_units.summary: Set explicit csv_null_marker="" for nyctaxi, clickbench, and amplab manifests
